body.statement:
For every loopless graph \(G\),
\[
 \mathcal P_{\mathcal I}^{\leq}(G)
 =\bigcup_{F:\,E(F)\subseteq E(G)}\mathcal P_{\mathcal I}(F).          \tag{20}
\]
For every loopless graph pair \(G,H\),
\[
 \mathcal P_{\mathcal I}^{\leq}(G)
 \subseteq\mathcal P_{\mathcal I}^{\leq}(H)
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 \operatorname{Cover}_{\mathcal I}^{\leq}(G,H).                       \tag{21}
\]
Consequently the two zero-allowed joint response-kernel model sets are equal if and only if both directed downward-closed cover relations hold.  This is a finite union over exact-support strata and retains one common coefficient matrix and one common source-law tuple across all regimes.
body.proof_tex:
Take a mechanism in \(\mathfrak M_{\mathcal I}^{\leq}(G)\), and let \(F\) be the unique loopless graph with edge set \(E(F)=\operatorname{supp}(B)\).  Then \(E(F)\subseteq E(G)\); all regime-solvability, source, and surgical-intervention conditions are unchanged, so the mechanism belongs to \(\mathfrak M_{\mathcal I}(F)\).  This proves the left-to-right inclusion in (20).  Conversely, if a mechanism belongs to \(\mathfrak M_{\mathcal I}(F)\) for some \(E(F)\subseteq E(G)\), then its exact support is contained in \(E(G)\), so it belongs to \(\mathfrak M_{\mathcal I}^{\leq}(G)\).  This proves (20).  The union is finite because a loopless graph has at most \(N(N-1)\) possible edges.

We prove (21).  Assume first the set containment and fix \(F\subseteq G\) and \(C\in\mathcal D_F\).  Exact mixing realization produces an exact-support, regime-solvable matrix on \(F\) with observed mixing \(C\).  Equip it with the diagnostic sources from Lemma \(\texttt{lem:diagnostic-mixture-rigidity}\).  Its response-kernel tuple lies in \(\mathcal P_{\mathcal I}^{\leq}(G)\), hence in \(\mathcal P_{\mathcal I}^{\leq}(H)\).  Choose a realizing zero-allowed \(H\)-mechanism, let \(K\) be its exact structural support, and let \(D\) be its observed mixing matrix.  Then \(E(K)\subseteq E(H)\), and exact mixing realization gives \(D\in\mathcal D_K\).

Equality of the observational kernels and diagnostic rigidity give a surjection \(f:U_C\twoheadrightarrow U_D\) and nonzero \(a_i\) satisfying \(C_{:,i}=a_iD_{:,f(i)}\).  For every \(S\), the pushforward lemma writes the equal kernels as translates of their equal residual law at \(x=0\).  Translation rigidity therefore gives \(T_S(C)=T_S(D)\), exactly as in equations (14).  Thus \((K,D,f,a)\) witnesses \(\operatorname{Cover}_{\mathcal I}^{\leq}(G,H)\).

Conversely, assume the downward-closed cover and take any zero-allowed \(G\)-mechanism.  Let \(F\subseteq G\) be its exact support and \(C\in\mathcal D_F\) its observed mixing matrix.  A cover witness supplies \(K\subseteq H\), \(D\in\mathcal D_K\), \(f\), and \(a\).  Exact mixing realization constructs the corresponding exact-support matrix on \(K\).  Define its visible sources by the single common grouping
\[
 \eta_j=\sum_{i:f(i)=j}a_i\varepsilon_i,\qquad j\in U_D,            \tag{22}
\]
and choose arbitrary legal independent sources on invisible columns.  As proved in unrestricted finite-mixture containment, (22) gives independent nonconstant non-Gaussian sources and \(C\varepsilon=D\eta\).  Proportionality and simultaneous response equality give equation (16) for every \(S\), hence
\[
 R_S(C)\varepsilon+T_S(C)x
 =R_S(D)\eta+T_S(D)x
\]
samplewise for all \(S\) and \(x\).  The pushforward lemma shows that the entire joint tuple is realized by this one \(K\)-mechanism and this one source tuple.  Because \(K\subseteq H\), it lies in \(\mathcal P_{\mathcal I}^{\leq}(H)\).  This proves the reverse implication in (21).  Applying (21) in both directions proves the equality criterion.  In particular, no monotone transfer of exact-support equality was assumed: the proof explicitly quantifies over every exact stratum \(F\subseteq G\), allows the target stratum \(K\subseteq H\) to depend on \(C\), and constructs the common multi-regime realization.
body.justification: The theorem extends the exact-support engine to the anchor zero-allowed class by proving the finite union over exact support strata and the corresponding source-stratum-to-target-stratum cover.
body.gap: Observational zero-allowed equivalence does not encode simultaneous intervention responses or prove that one coefficient matrix and source tuple realize every regime.
body.consumer: The same graph compiler can now report equivalence under either scientific convention: every displayed edge active, or displayed edges merely allowed.
